_readme: publishedAt/status for each prediction, keyed by its number heading in Predictions.md. Predictions.md is synced from blunderbus88/Bitcoin and carries no per-entry metadata of its own (see src/lib/predictions.ts). New prediction numbers are auto-added here by scripts/sync-predictions-meta.mjs (run from .github/workflows/sync-predictions.yml) with today's date and status "open" — edit status by hand here as predictions resolve.
